{{Quote|Having apparently worked out the details in secret with local promoters months ago, Hansor's team has taken up residence in the Sedratis Coliseum and has issued a challenge to the Destructors to evict him if they can!|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
The '''Sedratis Coliseum''' was located in [[Sedratis City]], within the [[Sedratis system/Legends|Sedratis system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Core Gladiator Walker League]] team [[Hansor's Hooligans]] arrived in the [[City/Legends|city]]&mdash;the hometown of its rival team, [[Demelza's Destructors]]&mdash;and took up residence at the Sedratis Coliseum. The Hooligans then issued a challenge for the Destructors to try and evict it from the structure, which led to fans eager to witness the showdown overwhelming electronic ticketing systems over the following twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].

==Description==
The Sedratis Coliseum was a structure in [[Sedratis City]], a [[City/Legends|settlement]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Sedratis system/Legends|Sedratis system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|With the unexpected arrival of Hansor’s Hooligans at Sedratis City last night, the local sports world has focused on what must be acknowledged as a dramatic turn of events.|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
[[File:Gladiatorwalker.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Core Gladiator Walker League (a gladiator walker pictured) team Hansor's Hooligans issued a challenge to the Demelza's Destructors team to attempt to evict it from the Sedratis Coliseum.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Core Gladiator Walker League]] team [[Hansor's Hooligans]], led by [[Madrix Hansor]], planned to issue a personal challenge to its bitter rival, the [[Demelza's Destructors]] team captained by [[Demelza Mintori]]. Secretly arranging the details with local promoters [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in advance,<ref name="Galladinium" /> at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Hooligans&mdash;unexpectedly to the public&mdash;arrived in Sedratis City, the hometown of the Destructors, and took up residence in the Sedratis Coliseum. Hansor's team then issued a challenge to Mintori's team to attempt to evict Hansor.<ref name="Galladinium" />

Over the subsequent period of less than twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], the demand from excited fans of the sport eager to spend more than five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on tickets to see the showdown of the two teams had already overwhelmed electronic ticketing systems, and a sellout was expected by the following [[Local day/Legends|day's]] evening. On the next day after the Hooligans' challenge was issued, the event involving the Sedratis Coliseum was mentioned in a news report that was subsequently included in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sedratis Coliseum was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
